stage1.impression: A dark, warm room with a fir-lined niche and two speakers on oak plinths. It reads as a well-composed hi-fi showroom render, not a night photograph of a specific bar. The fir is believable at a distance, but the floor and the foreground tub chair are flat dark masses. The ghosted figure on the right is large, semi-transparent and pink-headed, and reads as a composite. The smoked speakers sit glossy and neutral, with plastic highlights on the horns, so nothing in the frame says 'tinted cast acrylic'. A magazine would take it for a generic demo room, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The foreground and floor carry readable material (velvet nap, floor polish, pools of light from the Orbs) instead of a dark mass: tub chair region lum_median >= 14, crush_pct < 2
Both altar speakers are lit evenly as the hero, each region lum_median >= 50, within 20 % of each other
The figure reads as a guest caught on a long exposure, not a translucent overlay larger than the speakers
The frame shows something that makes it a specific place (concrete shell, steel, a table with a glass and an Orb), not a generic niche and a black void
The horns and the acrylic show soft, broad reflections instead of hard plastic speculars

defects.what: the motion-blurred figure is oversized, translucent, and overlaps the screen; its head is a pink-orange smear that reads as a compositing ghost
the foreground tub chair is a near-black blob with no velvet texture (lum_median 6.9, crush 7.2 %)
the floor is a featureless dark brown plane with no polish, reflection or texture (lum_range 25.5)
the left speaker is under-lit next to the right one (median 40 vs 69), and its horn shows hard white plastic-looking speculars
on the right speaker, the white batt behind the acrylic reads as an opaque white block, almost unshaded
the shell at upper right is an empty dark void (median 16, range 17): no concrete grain, beam or steel can be read
the two absorber panels behind the speakers are flat, untextured brown rectangles
the Orb lamp at the left edge is cut by the frame and its glow is close to clipping, with no pool of light on its table
the fir is the most saturated surface in the frame (r 105 / g 59 / b 39 at the soffit), so the room, not the product, carries the colour

changes.problem: The blurred guest is too large, too transparent and too close to the camera, so it reads as a pasted ghost and competes with the altar.

evidence.measured: the figure covers about 15 % of the frame; the head smear at [1050,250,1200,340] has r_median 73 against g 48 and sits over the screen

change.from: 1 in the near-right tub chair; shutter 1.0 frame; head travel [0.16, 0.1, 0.04] m, turn 30 deg
change.to: the same guest seated in a mid-ground tub chair facing the altar (about 2.5 to 3 m from the camera), shutter 0.5 frame, head travel [0.06, 0.04, 0.02] m, turn 12 deg, so the torso holds and only the head and hands soften

changes.expected: One guest who reads as a person listening, about the height of a plinth in the frame. No translucent smear over the screen.

changes.problem: The foreground and the floor have no light of their own, so the chairs and the floor go to mud and the room feels empty, not cozy.

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Orb power and glow
change.to: 3.0 W, glow 0.012, with an Orb on each oak table between the tub chairs, so each one throws a warm pool on its table top and the chair arms beside it

changes.expected: Pools of 2400 K light on the tables with falloff onto the velvet arms and floor. The chair's nap and the floor's sheen become readable while the frame stays low key.

changes.problem: The left speaker of the hero pair is under-lit, and the hard spots put plastic-looking speculars on the horns.

evidence.measured: lum_median 40.1 (target >= 45) against 69.0 for the right speaker [640,265,760,540]; horn p95 208 in small hard streaks

change.setting: lamps: the altar spots and the Ember speaker area lamps
change.from: 2 x spot 38.0 W, cone 24 deg; area 0.5 W/m2
change.to: 2 x spot 48 W, cone 36 deg with a soft edge, re-aimed so each centres on its own speaker's cabinet; area lamps 1.2 W/m2

changes.expected: Both speakers lit evenly. Light shows through the smoked acrylic onto the batts, and the horns get broad, soft reflections instead of streaks.

changes.problem: At 28 mm from 4.3 m, the frame is a third empty floor and black shell, and the altar is small. It reads as a wide showroom record shot, not an intimate seated view.

evidence.measured: the floor and dead right side fill the lower third and right third at lum ~18 to 33

change.to: position about [13.3, 4.6, 1.10] (seated eye level in the second row), lens 40 mm, f/2.8, focused on the near speaker's plinth; keep one tub-chair back and an Orb table in the near foreground

changes.expected: The altar fills about half the frame height. Chair backs, a table and a lamp frame it. Less dead floor, more 'I am sitting in this room'.

changes.problem: The upper right shell is a flat void, so the board-formed concrete, beams and steel that would make it a specific place are invisible.

change.setting: the room's light: add grazing light on the shell; haze
change.from: no light on the right-hand shell wall; haze 0.006/m
change.to: the record wall's spots raised 6.0 W -> 12 W, with one tilted to graze the concrete beside the zone at a low angle; haze 0.012/m

changes.expected: Pour lines, tie holes and a beam edge readable in the upper right, with faint beams in the haze under the altar spots.

changes.problem: With the smoked products neutral, the fir becomes the frame's most saturated colour, against the brief's rule that colour comes only from the products.

evidence.measured: r_median 135, g 89, b 63 on the fir wall

change.setting: render: white_balance_k, and the fir's tone
change.to: 3300 K, tint 0; fir desaturated about 15 % and darkened 10 % (a less orange oil finish)

changes.expected: The fir reads as warm timber, not orange. The smoked speakers and the lamp glows hold their own.

changes.problem: Nothing near the camera shows that someone is using the room, so it lacks life and specificity.

evidence.measured: only a cut-off Orb and a dark chair in the foreground; no glass, record or coat visible

change.from: 1 rocks, 1 votives (none visible in the foreground)
change.to: on the near oak table under the Orb: a rocks glass with a finger of whisky and a record sleeve; a coat over the near tub chair's arm, catching the Orb's light

changes.expected: Small highlights on glass and sleeve in the lower left, and a sign of life in the frame.

changes.problem: The floor reads as matte dark paint, with no polish to pick up the altar and the lamps.

evidence.measured: profile on y falls smoothly 33.8 -> 13.3 with no reflection or variation

change.to: a satin sealed finish (roughness about 0.35) with faint tonal mottling, so the plinths and the lamp pools leave soft reflections

changes.expected: Soft vertical reflections of the plinths and the Orb glow on the floor. Floor lum_range rises.

out_of_scope.request: Make the white batt behind the right speaker's upper acrylic less of a flat white block
out_of_scope.why: The batts are part of the fixed speaker. Only the light on them may change (c3 should help).

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a visible tint so one saturated colour carries the frame
out_of_scope.why: The configuration is Smoke, the house configuration, and the speaker colour is fixed. If the hero must carry colour, the owner would have to pick another configuration for this shot.

out_of_scope.request: Texture or replace the flat brown absorber panels behind the speakers
out_of_scope.why: They are part of the niche design the card fixes.
